svg.text: masked bytes updated; other bytes retained
Default loaders: 64 B memory line / 32 B MatrixReg bank word
C store transpose uses block reorder; tail elements in the final full line are zero-filled.
Parameterized loaders use a different response bridge; their feature boundaries are documented separately.
